title: Fix — apply_fix dry-run preview then clear a broken soft reference

steps.title: Prerequisites
steps.body: Editor open on the demo project with the bridge answering ping; typed-editor tool group visible (activate via unreal_open_mcp_manage_tools if needed). This scenario re-stages the same broken soft object pointer as core-gate-fail so it runs independently, then drives the clear_broken_soft_reference fix end to end. The contract: unreal_open_mcp_apply_fix defaults to dry_run true — always preview first. The dry run reports what would change with no mutation and no gate. Only after reviewing the preview, apply with dry_run false under gate enforce so a rollback snapshot protects the asset. You will need the issue_id from the validate_edit call — copy it from the actual envelope before the apply step.

steps.title: Stage the broken soft reference (same fixture as core-gate-fail)
Scan the Blueprint to obtain the issue_id
Expected outcomes (scan)
items: validate_edit returns a broken_soft_reference finding for the Blueprint.
Copy the finding's issue_id (ruleId|severity|assetPath|issueCode) — the next two steps use it.

steps.title: Preview the fix (dry_run true) — no mutation

args.issue_id: <paste the broken_soft_reference issue_id from the scan>

steps.title: Expected outcomes (dry-run preview)
items: ok is true; the result describes clearing the soft object pointer at Weapon on the Blueprint.
Nothing was written — the preview reports dryRun true / applied false and no touchedPaths.
The gate was skipped (dry_run bypasses the gate entirely).

steps.title: Apply the fix (dry_run false, gate enforce)
Expected outcomes (apply + re-scan)
items: success is true and the package was saved (the fix clears the property and SavePackage writes the change).
A follow-up validate_edit on the same Blueprint returns zero broken_soft_reference findings.
gate.validation.passed is true and gate.delta.newErrors is 0 under enforce (the fix resolved the only issue).

steps.title: Paste the agent output (validate_edit + apply_fix dry-run + apply-fix + re-scan envelopes)

reset.note: Reset deletes the disposable Blueprint under /Game/_ValidationSuite/. The fix itself already cleared the soft pointer and saved the package, so delete is the only remaining cleanup. No demo asset is ever modified.
